_note: The website needs the RECEIVER address (address) — where payments go (your receiving test wallet, or the IoT device address if you reuse it). payerPrivateKey is only for the BUILT-IN M2M agent (/run/* paths) in real mode.
_note_topology: Facilitator branch: the merchant writes this address into the payment request it opens with the facilitator, and the facilitator verifies payments AGAINST IT. The merchant itself never reads the chain.
_note_x402: x402 v2 (parallel mode, test ETH configuration): x402SettlerPrivateKey is the server's/facilitator's SETTLEMENT key for the official x402 protocol run (settlement is synthetic in mock); x402Address is the receiving address. Not needed in mock mode.
